text:
sam.lee: Heads up — Tidebank asked for a 4-week pilot for a fraud-detection/chat assistant. Wed 10am PT kickoff with their engineering + security. Need POC scope: success criteria, golden prompts, scoring, regression gates, and outstanding security/pricing asks. Who can own the eval harness?

maria.ortiz: I can own the harness + golden dataset. Will need sample transcripts (20-50) and the top 10 fraud scenarios. Also need SLA targets from them (p99 latency, throughput).

devon.kim: I’ll own infra sizing and the Dedicated pricing estimate. Quick Q: will they send PII to our hosted API or do they want private deployment? That changes cost a lot.

ashley.ng: @devon.kim they said likely VPC/private for compliance but still want to evaluate hosted for feature parity. Security questionnaire due next Friday — I’ll flag any blockers.

secops-bot: Reminder: security questionnaire template v2 is at https://redwood/sq-templates. Share filled answers in #eng-security for review.

maria.ortiz: Preliminary success criteria suggestion: 1) Precision@K (top-1) >= 85% on fraud label, 2) False positive rate <= 3% for flagged transactions, 3) p95 latency < 300ms for local calls, 4) No blocking security findings on data handling. Thoughts?

sam.lee: Those look good. Add an acceptance gate for prompt regressions: no more than 5% relative drop on the golden set vs baseline after any model change.

maria.ortiz: Agreed. Drafting the golden prompts now — sample seeds below (we'll expand to 200+ later):
```
PROMPT_001: "User reports an unauthorized transfer of $3,200 at 2:14AM PST — summarize likely fraud indicators and next recommended action."
PROMPT_002: "Customer disputes a merchant charge flagged by our system; ask clarifying Qs to verify transaction context."
PROMPT_003: "Given a list of transaction attributes (amount, geo, device_id, recent_velocity), classify as FRAUD/LEGIT and explain top 2 signals."
```

maria.ortiz: Scoring rubric (proposed): NLU correctness (0-3), Actionability (0-2), Hallucination risk (0-2), Response brevity (0-1). Total 0-8. Pass threshold 6+. We'll run automated scoring + 3 human labelers for edge cases.

devon.kim: For infra: if they want VPC + Dedicated pool sized for 50 TPS peak with bursts to 200 TPS, estimate requires 4x A100 equiv reserved, autoscale buffer. Ballpark cost = ~$28k-$42k/month depending on commit term. I'll formalize.

ashley.ng: Security asks: data retention window? Are they okay with dev logs masked? Do they require customer-managed KMS/HSM? Ask them to fill the specific sections in the questionnaire: DataFlow, KeyMgmt, AuditLogging.

sam.lee: I'll push an agenda for Wed kickoff: 1) Confirm use cases & golden set ownership; 2) Security Qs; 3) Deployment preference & SLAs; 4) Pricing incl. Dedicated vs Private; 5) Success metrics & regression gating.

maria.ortiz: Immediate action items: - @sam.lee ask Tidebank for 30 anonymized transcripts + top 10 fraud scenarios by EOD Tue - @devon.kim send initial cost ballpark doc by Tue EOD - @ashley.ng pull the SQ template and highlight mandatory fields by Tue noon

sam.lee: Doing it now. I'll DM legal to check if we can accept masked PII sample transcripts. :thumbsup:

secops-bot: Note: if they require HSM, Private deployment onboarding adds ~3 weeks to timeline.

maria.ortiz: Timeline attempt: week 0 kickoff & data ingest; week 1 build harness + seed goldens; week 2 run baseline evals + tune prompts; week 3 run regression tests + security review; week 4 handoff + production smoke.

sam.lee: Perfect — will include that in the kickoff slide. Thanks team.

ashley.ng: I'll coordinate with @eng-security after they return the SQ. If anything major, escalate to sales leadership.

maria.ortiz: One more: for regression gating, I propose automated nightly runs and an alert if total score drops >5% OR NLU correctness drops >7% on the golden set. Human review required before rollback.

sam.lee: Agreed. Closing for now — sending invites and initial asks. Thanks all.
